title: Onboarding to New Relic Platform - IPEX
content:
Purpose

This document’s purpose is to provide initial steps on how to get started with New-Relic APM solution for monitoring your application and other platforms. It should be seen as a guide to start with New-relic solution, each project might need additional configuration and process to get started. This document also tries to explain how to form an observability/monitoring team and process in brief with simple and kickoff early steps.

Program is driven by IPEX DevOps team lead by joakim.hogart@inter.ikea.com (Solution Architect) supported by

  1. external.sambit.patanaik@inter.ikea.com (Performance Engineer and monitoring specialist)

  2. sigurdur.orn.birgisson@inter.ikea.com (QA lead IPEX)

  3. New Relic Team (rbabu@newrelic.com and sgjessingsepstrup@newrelic.com)

  4. andrea.mazzotti@inter.ikea.com (Platform leader Devops)

Key Steps

  • Onboard your team

  • Request New-Relic Subaccounts

  • Go through Knowledge base for user management

  • Go through Knowledge base for New Relic

  • Identify monitoring areas

  • Identify New-Relic hands-on user type

  • create observability team- core users

  • Configure OR Setup monitoring

  • Create visibility platform

  • share in common platform

Onboard your team

An important first step in this process to onboard team and team members (with a team description) to the DevOps platform via

https://interikea.service-now.com/help?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=4836adc58739b810dffeecec3fbb35e7&sysparm_category=b062437fdb5d3c10f589d3ca4b961972

Provide the necessary inputs or fill in the fields with cost center, team owner etc and SUBMIT the form. This request is used to onboard and new team to the Devops platform .

Request New-Relic Subaccounts

https://interikea.service-now.com/help?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=28d1014887bfb010dffeecec3fbb35dd&sysparm_category=b062437fdb5d3c10f589d3ca4b961972

Use the above link to create the NR subaccounts . This request will help in creating the project groups in MS Azure AD for future user management.

Knowledge base for User management

https://interikea.service-now.com/help?sys_kb_id=dfbcaeea1bd970109b1b99bd2e4bcb44&id=kb_article_view&sysparm_rank=2&sysparm_tsqueryId=d1d5348187c64d1851ebbaec8bbb3583

By default the following Security Groups will be created for you:

  1. <TeamName>-Admin

  2. <TeamName>-Contrib

  3. <TeamName>-Read

  4. <TeamName>-Guest

Additionally, the following GitHub Teams will be created in the Inter-IKEA-Digital organization and will be mapped to the related Security Groups:

  1. <TeamName> Admins

  2. <TeamName> Contributors

  3. <TeamName> Readers

https://interikea.service-now.com/help?sys_kb_id=dda15a2d871c415451ebbaec8bbb35ca&id=kb_article_view&sysparm_rank=3&sysparm_tsqueryId=9e16b4c187c64d1851ebbaec8bbb3532

Identify Monitoring areas

The most important aspect of using the solution is to understand your monitoring requirement. Based on the complexity of the application the monitoring requirement , audience , sustainability and maintainability will vary .

For example : An application (e.g: NKP) with multiple tiers, multiple vendors, multiple dependency and different life cycle of it’s various component will have different requirement and sustainability strategy when compared to an single page application (e.g Ordna) which will mostly focus on end user performance.

Below are few recommendations on monitoring types to start with:

  • Availability

  • Synthetics for performance/response time

  • Hosts/ Infrastructure

  • Browser data (user session)

  • Monitoring Logs

it’s important also have a clear vision based on your team’s SLA and NFR if defined , to correlate with your monitoring type and need.

Identify NR User type

There are various type of user which can be created in NR . The cost to project varies accordingly . An important step in getting started is to understand the core group of Admins, Contributors, readers .

Create NR Observability team- Core users

Define roles and responsibility of Core users who are your gateway to NR.

Responsibility:

  • Maintain relationship with New Relic.

  • Coordinators of accounts and users with IPEX core team and NR

  • Creating project knowledge base

  • collaboration and sharing with different projects

  • create monitoring , dashboards, alerts etc
